Tasks:

Get started as a reachtruck driver at DSV on the day shift in Desteldonk for €16.80/hour plus €10 meal vouchers!

As a reachtruck driver, you will ensure the warehouse at the logistics site in Desteldonk keeps running smoothly. You will ensure a fluent and correct flow of goods. You combine your reach truck experience with an active work attitude and contribute to a streamlined process within an international network.

Are you looking for a new long-term challenge? Apply today via talentcenter40@randstad.be or 09 218 79 35!

Our AI agent Rani will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions to check whether you meet the minimum requirements for the job. Our consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have any questions about this screening, please contact us.

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for for this vacancy?

• You hold a valid reachtruck certificate or have gained the necessary experience as a reachtruck driver.
• You are flexible and willing to work day hours from 8:00 AM - 4:36 PM, 9:00 AM - 5:36 PM, or 10:00 AM - 6:36 PM.
• You are looking for a long-term challenge.
• You have a good command of Dutch or English, allowing you to easily understand and follow work instructions and safety guidelines.
• You can easily reach the site in Desteldonk using your own transportation.
In the role of reachtruck driver, you will carry out the following tasks:

• Safely and efficiently loading and unloading goods.
• Accurately storing and putting away incoming shipments in the correct rack locations with a reachtruck.
• Performing quality control checks upon receipt of goods.
• Flexibly assisting as an order picker in the warehouse when there is less reach truck work.

Pattyn Group (€158 million turnover), headquartered in Bruges, is a pioneer in automated packaging solutions. We specialize in bulk packaging for a wide range of industries, including food, pharmaceuticals, and industrial goods. We design and build innovative, high-quality packaging machinery that seamlessly integrates into production lines, helping customers improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance product safety throughout the packaging process.
 

We operate in five countries, with production sites in Bruges (Pattyn Belgium & Pattyn Metal Construction), Deerlijk (Pattyn Bulk Packaging), France (Pattyn France) and Spain (GMP) as well as sales and service centers in Kuala Lumpur (Pattyn Asia) and North America (Pattyn North America). With over 250 employees in Belgium and more than 600 colleagues worldwide, we continue to grow and strengthen our position as a global partner in packaging technology.
 

As a proud member of the 
Duravant family, a global leader in engineered equipment and automation solutions, Pattyn benefits from an extensive international network, strategic investments, and access to cutting-edge technologies. This partnership enables us to further expand our expertise, accelerate innovation, and deliver groundbreaking packaging solutions to customers around the world. Driven by a passionate team of professionals, we continuously push the boundaries of packaging automation while fostering an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and rewarding environment where talented people can grow and make an impact.
 

Your challenge
 

The Group Accounting & Internal Controls Manager is responsible for ensuring consistent, accurate and compliant accounting practices across all Pattyn Group entities. 
 

The role drives the standardization of accounting policies, safeguards the integrity of financial reporting and internal controls, and acts as the primary point of contact for external auditors across the Group. 
 

In addition, the position plays a key role in improving the efficiency and reliability of financial closing processes, strengthening financial governance and supporting local finance teams in applying Group standards and best practices.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Group Accounting Governance & Compliance 

• External Audit Management 

• Internal Controls & SOX Compliance 

• Balance Sheet Integrity & Reconciliations 

• Financial Closing & Process Improvement 

• Stakeholder Management & Capability Building  

 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field; professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA or equivalent) preferred. 

• Minimum 7 years of relevant experience, preferably including Big 4 audit and/or Group Accounting in a multinational environment. 

• Strong knowledge of IFRS and/or US GAAP, consolidation, SOX compliance and internal control frameworks. 

• Proven experience in external audit management and international accounting practices. 

• Strong analytical skills, technical rigor and attention to detail, with a high standard for accuracy and compliance. 

• Process-driven and improvement-oriented, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and implement practical solutions. 

• Strong ownership, organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority and coach local finance teams. 

• Strong ERP knowledge, advanced Excel skills and affinity with digitalization and automation. 

• Fluent English; French is a strong asset.

Do you have kitchen experience and enjoy working with fresh products? Are you hands-on, reliable, and looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Then we would love to meet you!
 

Your responsibilities
 

As a Production Kitchen Worker, you will be part of a motivated team responsible for preparing and processing fresh vegetables on a daily basis.
 

Your tasks include:
 

 
• Cleaning and washing vegetables.
 
• Cutting and preparing vegetables both manually and with machines.
 
• Operating vegetable cutting equipment safely and efficiently.
 
• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.
 
• Following quality and food safety standards. 

 
• Previous experience in a professional kitchen is required.
 
• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.
 
• You work accurately and pay attention to hygiene.
 
• You are available to work on Mondays and Saturdays.
 
• You can start work between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
 
• You speak English or Dutch.
 
• Experience working in Belgium is not required.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
 

 
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
 
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner
 
• Assisting with filling the tunnels
 
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn
 
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!) 

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
 

 
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner
 
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)
 
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently
 
• You speak Dutch, French or English

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
 

 
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system
 
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)
 
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace
 
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift 

 
• You hold a valid forklift certificate
 
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• You work accurately and value order and structure
 
• Safety is always your top priority
 
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

For our client, a family-run and growing company based in IZEGEM, we are looking for a production worker to strengthen the team. Do you enjoy working with fresh products, are you precise, and not afraid to work in a cooled environment? Then keep reading!
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Cleaning, cutting, and packaging fruits and vegetables

Working hours (full-time):

• Tuesday to Friday: 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 1:30 PM – 4:00 PM
 
• Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:25 PM 

 
• You speak Dutch or English
 
• You work accurately and hygienically
 
• Previous experience in the food industry is a plus, but not required
 
• You are physically fit and motivated

Part electrical, part mechanical, and no two days are the same. Callewaert Industries Technical Support is looking for an electromechanical technician to join a 2-shift team at one of our clients in the Roeselare area. You'll be employed by Callewaert Industries and work as part of the client's maintenance team.
 

The job
 

•
 You track down and fix breakdowns, roughly half electrical, half mechanical.
 

•
 You keep production lines and machinery up and running.
 

•
 Mechanical repairs and part replacements are yours to handle, and you troubleshoot electrical faults on your own.
 

•
 You log every job accurately and keep the maintenance team in the loop.

•
 You're as comfortable with a multimeter as with a spanner.
 

•
 You've worked as an electromechanic or maintenance technician in a production environment.
 

•
 You work independently and never cut corners on safety.
 

•
 You speak Dutch or English.

For a leading player in the Belgian logistics sector, we are looking for a CE Driver for the Ghent site.

For the Ghent site, we are looking for a CE Driver who enjoys working with a dedicated tractor unit and a flexible day schedule.

Your responsibilities

• Prepare each trip carefully and perform the necessary vehicle checks

• Verify transport documents and ensure load safety

• Couple and uncouple trailers

• Occasionally assist with loading and unloading goods

• Report any issues or delays to the planning team in a timely manner

• Carry out safe and efficient deliveries to customers and the airport

Who are you?

• You hold a valid CE driving licence

• You have previous experience as a CE Driver

• You possess a valid digital driver card, ADR certificate, Code 95, and medical certificate

• You are willing to work a flexible schedule, starting from 5:00 AM

• You are comfortable using GPS systems and other driving support tools

• You communicate effectively in Dutch, French or English

• You are customer-oriented, reliable, and responsible

• Safety and quality are always your top priorities

• You have a genuine passion for transport and logistics

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
 

 
 

Within Nike's European Logistics Campus, supply chain is at the heart of the athlete and consumer experience
 

Our ambition is to accelerate service, efficiency and cost improvements by combining data-driven problem solving with end-to-end solution design.
 

Within our organization, there are different teams where you could bring your expertise, with a focus on areas such as transportation, planning and operations.
 

You will work closely with operational teams, analysts, specialists, managers, and internal and external partners across our logistics network. Together, we connect expertise across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to improve performance faster and at scale.
 

You will contribute to one strong team, focused on delivering for athletes and consumers while continuously raising the bar in logistics.
 

 
 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
 

 
 
 

• Own and improve day-to-day performance: Monitor supply chain and logistics performance, identify deviations and translate insights into clear actions with the right owners and timing. 

• Turn data into decisions: Combine operational information and analytical insights to identify root causes, opportunities, risks and practical recommendations. 

• Automate day-to-day workflows: Identify repetitive, manual or fragmented activities and help redesign them into simpler, standardized and automated workflows. Partner with process owners and technology teams to define requirements, test solutions, support implementation and track adoption and value. 

• Drive continuous improvement: Structure and deliver improvement initiatives with clear scope, milestones, risks, expected outcomes and measurable business value. 

• Design end-to-end solutions: Work across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to connect local improvements to the wider logistics network. 

• Support implementation: Stay close to the operation from problem definition through testing, deployment, stabilization and handover. 

• Build scalable ways of working: Create clear processes, documentation, dashboards and routines that make improvements sustainable and reusable across teams. 

• Engage stakeholders: Facilitate discussions, align different perspectives and communicate progress, decisions and next steps clearly. 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

 
 
 

• ACT WITH URGENCYYou don’t wait for the perfect conditions. You step in, take ownership and stay close to the action. You turn insights into decisions and decisions into momentum. 

• LEAD WITH HOWHow you win matters. You bring analytical thinking and a problem-solving mindset, challenge the status quo and make the complex simple. You communicate with clarity, bring people along and build strong partnerships across the business. 

• BE FLEXIBLEThe game can change fast, and you’re ready to move with it. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, navigate ambiguity with confidence and adapt as priorities shift. You’re curious to learn different parts of the supply chain and ready to contribute wherever you can create impact. 

• PLAY TO WINYou keep your eyes on the finish line. You focus on solutions that work, value that can be measured and improvements that make a real difference. You don’t stop at the idea. You help bring it to life.  

 
 

YOUR SPORTS BAG CONTAINS
 
 

• A bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience, in supply chain, logistics, engineering, business analytics or a related field. 

• You bring a strong interest in supply chain and have built relevant knowledge or hands-on experience through your education, internships, projects or professional experience in areas such as supply chain, distribution, logistics, project delivery or process improvement. 

• Strong project-management skills, with experience structuring work around clear deliverables, milestones, risks and expected outcomes. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data and operational information into clear insights and recommendations. 

• Experience identifying workflow improvement opportunities and translating business needs into standardized or automated processes. Experience with workflow, analytics or automation tools is an asset. 

• The ability to work independently while collaborating across teams, functions and organizational levels. 

• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. 

• Professional proficiency in English. Dutch is an asset. 

• Curiosity, adaptability and a willingness to learn new processes, technologies and areas of the supply chain. 

• Experience with analytics tools, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, process mapping, simulation or supply chain technology is an asset.  

 
 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 
 

• Operational issues are translated into clear actions and sustainable improvements. 

• Manual day-to-day activities are simplified, standardized or automated where this adds value. 

• Projects deliver measurable service, cost, quality or productivity improvements. 

• Solutions are implemented successfully, adopted by the operation and scalable beyond one team or process. 

• Stakeholders understand the priorities, decisions, ownership and next steps.

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Job Description

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Your Role
 
• Design, implement, and improve automated unit and regression tests 
• Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code migration, test generation, 
refactoring, and documentation
 
• Establish and monitor code coverage metrics 
• Integrate testing, coverage analysis, and regression checks into the existing CI/CD pipeline 
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize future software migration efforts 
• Use and improve best practices for integrating AI coding assistants into software modernization workflows 
• Collaborate with senior software developers and imaging experts to validate functionality and quality 
Your Profile
 
• Bachelor's or Master's student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
• Strong affinity with software development, testing, automation and development infrastructure 
• Experience with C++ development, experience with other programming languages is a plus 
• Familiarity with git and CI/CD concepts is an asset 
• Curious and eager to explore new tools, technologies, and environments 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English/Dutch and a collaborative mindset

EDR Antwerp Shipyard is the largest shipyard in Belgium, specialised in ship maintenance and repairs, hull treatment and marine construction. Challenging activities require skilful and motivated team members. Over 150 vessels annually are repaired and maintained at our shipyard in Antwerp, and projects are performed on board vessels across the world.
 

As a 
Crane Operator, you play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and well organised lifting operations within and around our dry dock. You will primarily operate one of our 
five cranes and support a wide range of dockside activities that contribute directly to vessel repair and maintenance projects. You will join a close knit team of experienced crane operators where teamwork and safety are central.
 

RESPONSIBILITIES
 

• Operate one of the 
five cranes on site, including a Wolff tower crane, a Wolff luffing jib crane and three fully restored shipyard cranes with lifting capacities of up to 100 tonnes
 

• Carry out lifting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and operational requirements
 

• Support signalling and guidance of lifting movements in areas with limited visibility or restricted access
 

• Assist with dry dock operations (such as the positioning of docking blocks)
 

• Actively support crane operations by maintaining clear lifting zones, monitoring traffic routes and minimising downtime
 

• Coordinate incoming materials and deliveries, ensuring safe and appropriate storage locations are assigned
 

• Serve as a communication link between subcontractors, shipyard teams, vessel crews and fellow crane operators
 

• Provide basic rigging support and assist colleagues in selecting and using suitable lifting equipment
 

• Maintain good order, cleanliness and safety standards around the dry dock area
 

• Identify, report and document damage, deviations and unsafe situations
 

• Support other operational activities on site when crane work is temporarily unavailable
 

 
 

#ontmoetingsdag

• Good knowledge of English, which is the primary language used for operational communication, radio contact and coordination with subcontractors and vessel crews
 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage for internal coordination and site instructions. Knowledge of Polish and/or Romanian is considered a strong asset
 

• Strong safety awareness and the ability to maintain oversight and prioritise effectively in a dynamic work environment
 

• Confident communicator with a practical and collaborative approach
 

• Hands on attitude and a consistent commitment to agreed procedures and safety standards
 

• Experience with crane operations, forklifts and/or mobile elevated work platforms is highly advantageous
 

• Flexibility to align working hours (daytime hours) with operational requirements, deliveries and lifting schedules
 

• Weekend work may occur, but is not mandatory and will be arranged in consultation with the other colleagues
